note.zh-TW: 模板列在流動負債，性質教材沒有說明；台灣實務對照存入保證金（多屬非流動）或代收款，等老師確認（T15）。
note.en: The template lists it under current liabilities without defining it; in Taiwanese practice it maps to guarantee deposits received (usually non-current) or collections on behalf of others, pending the teacher (T15).

definition.zh-TW: 從客戶或他人收到、將來要退還的保證金。它是負債，因為這筆錢終究要還；本課的故事沒有用到。
definition.en: Deposits received from customers or others that will have to be returned. It is a liability because the money must eventually be given back; the course story does not use it.
